title: PC-03: low-multipole suppression in the CMB from a finite hyperbolic substrate

statements.text: Low-multipole suppression in the CMB from a finite hyperbolic substrate.
statements.scope: a prediction candidate, not a frozen prediction row
statements.conditions: Where it stands: E-CSM-0051, on a {7,3} tiling, finds the suppression is a generic finite-size effect and reports the hyperbolic-persistence conjecture falsified. No preferred-axis experiment exists. What it needs: a suppression specific to {3,4,3,4}, set against the measured low-$\ell$ power.

standing.reason: a candidate: it has not passed the prediction gate
